BEFORE YOU GET STARTED

Questions about working with HeyDock.

Can you work under our brand?+

Yes. We scope white-label engineer dispatch and project support for IT providers. We agree who communicates with the end customer, how issues are escalated and what evidence is handed back.

Can I start with a single engineer visit?+

Yes. Share the site, preferred date, task and required skills. We can then discuss availability and the scope before confirming a booking.

Can you help us choose between ready-made and custom software?+

Yes. We can compare the available options against your process, budget and integration requirements, then scope configuration or custom development where appropriate.

What should I include in a project brief?+

Describe the problem, the affected sites or users, the systems involved and your target dates. Tell us what a successful result would look like.

IN MORE DETAIL

IT support, software and AI automation for businesses

HeyDock provides technology services for businesses and IT partners. We work with direct business customers and IT providers that need additional delivery capacity. Our offering combines on-site engineering, remote technical resources, ready-made business software, custom development and AI automation. The engagement may be a single authorised site visit, a software implementation or an ongoing service with defined responsibilities.

For business teams, the first question is usually what needs to work better: employee devices, customer support, internal processes or disconnected applications. For IT partners, it may be engineering availability, a rollout deadline or a customer location outside the existing team’s reach. Those are different buying needs, so our service pages explain the delivery model, prerequisites and questions to resolve before starting.

Our UK and European coverage is based on available engineers and confirmed requirements. Remote services can extend the available options, but working hours, data access and technical skills still need to match the job. We do not substitute broad geographical claims for a confirmed site booking.
